primary_goal: 在不重开 H28 request coverage、H30 storage 或 H33 evidence identity 的前提下，检查预测输入身份、shape/hardware coverage 和 fallback 泛化边界中的可复现缺陷。
method: prepare -> verify -> predict -> score -> review -> promote

baseline.role: H33 negative reproducibility scan plus H28 prediction/evaluation baseline

previous_direction: 开发工具链与可复现性（H33）
direction_switch_reason: H33 可复现性负向收口；预测/generalization 是当前最长未重新扫描方向，H34 检查输入身份和域外 fallback，不重复 H28 request coverage。
recent_directions: H34:预测输入/泛化边界（活动）

scope.candidate: prediction input fingerprints, shape/hardware coverage, unknown/fallback domain and score/report identity
exclude: Native accuracy claims without independent Native data

problem_domain_closure.rule: 同一预测输入根因直接影响的身份、域外、fallback、结果状态和 API 必须同轮收口；无候选保留负结论。

data_roles.development: fresh prediction source scan and controlled input/fallback probes
data_roles.final_acceptance: mechanism/generalization contract only; no Native accuracy unless independently observed

guardrails: 不得把单测通过称为精度改善
不得重复 H28 request coverage
没有 Native 时只报告机制/泛化边界
未知/域外保持显式 unknown/fallback
next_step: 完成独立 prediction/generalization source scan，登记唯一可证伪候选。
